h: Smart moves for a Manchester mission
p: Want to give yourselves the best chance of escaping? Start by searching properly. Teams often rush the first few minutes, then spend ages hunting for something they walked straight past. Open drawers, check pockets, flip things over and gather every find in one place. After that, it's all about connections: which number fits which lock, which symbol matches which picture. Keep talking the whole time and you'll be surprised how quickly things click.
The Corn Exchange is a handsome Edwardian building in its own right, so take a minute to look up at the glass roof and old stonework on your way in. It's a far cry from a bland retail unit.

Once you've escaped, the streets around Exchange Square are full of character. Just beyond the cathedral sits Chetham's Library, one of the oldest public libraries in the country, tucked away in a medieval building that feels like stepping back centuries. Victoria station is a few minutes' walk away for trains and trams, and the Northern Quarter, with its independent shops, record stores, street art and bars, is an easy stroll east. For more history, the John Rylands Library on Deansgate is a stunning neo-Gothic gem, free to visit, while the Science and Industry Museum in Castlefield tells the story of the city that helped power the Industrial Revolution. Plenty to keep a group busy before or after the game.
